value.rationale: The full modular group-algebra automorphism count, not merely the underlying abstract group automorphism count, is a natural structural invariant, and its p-core and reductive quotient vary with cyclic-factor heights. The exact extension-field socle-scalar image and equidistribution sharpen a known general constraint by exhibiting precisely which scalars occur, with concrete finite-field divisibility boundary. These are uniform results over every abelian p-group and finite extension field rather than arbitrary isolated computations.
